what: Ciena makes optical networking equipment: the systems that carry data as light over long distances, plus the routing and software that manage those networks. Cloud and AI operators have become a larger share of its customers than telecom carriers.
customers: Cloud providers and data centre operators, telecom carriers, cable companies and governments.
money: optical transport, coherent optics and routing
network management software, installation and support
moat: Coherent optical technology developed in-house, where a handful of companies in the world can build the chips that pack more data into a single fibre.
risks: Operating margin of about 4% is thin for a technology company
Telecom carrier spending is cyclical and has been weak
A few very large cloud customers account for a growing share of revenue
opportunities: Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
AI data centres connected across sites need exactly the long-haul optical capacity it sells
watch: Orders from cloud customers and gross margin as the mix shifts.
